en.title: Features
en.meta_description: Every module shipped in Project NEXUS v1.6, with honest maturity labels for timebanking, federation, learning, marketplace, community care, safety, analytics, and open-source infrastructure.
en.heading: What Project NEXUS does
en.subheading: Project NEXUS is an enterprise-grade, multi-tenant community platform. Every module below ships in v2.0.0 today. We label modules honestly: unmarked items are Generally Available; newer or actively-hardening surfaces carry a Beta or Preview chip; and a Built, not enabled chip means the work is finished and switched off, waiting for demand.
en.maturity_ga: Generally Available - stable, supported, used in production across pilot tenants.
en.maturity_beta: Working in production today, but the public surface or wire protocol is still being hardened.
en.maturity_preview: Recently shipped and available to opt in. Expect rapid iteration - the API and UX may change.
en.open_source_body: Project NEXUS is fully open source under AGPL-3.0. Every line of code is auditable, forkable, and self-hostable. Federation protocols are documented as open standards so no single platform controls the global timebanking network.
en.security_body_before: Found a security issue? Please report it privately to
en.security_body_after: rather than filing a public issue. Full vulnerability-disclosure policy in SECURITY.md on the source repository.

tech_stack.ai_value: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, with Anthropic, Google Gemini and self-hosted Ollama supported behind the same interface
tech_stack.frontend_value: React 19 + TypeScript + HeroUI v3 + Tailwind CSS 4, built with Vite 7
tech_stack.mobile_value: Expo / React Native (Android release-ready, iOS pending)
tech_stack.accessible_value: GOV.UK Frontend 6.4 + Express + Nunjucks, HTML-first and works without JavaScript

timebanking_engine.title: Timebanking Engine
timebanking_engine.description: Full credit exchange system with wallet, transactions, and broker controls.

multi_tenancy.title: Multi-Tenancy
multi_tenancy.description: Host unlimited communities on a single platform, each with their own branding, configuration, and feature set.

tenant_hierarchy.title: Tenant Hierarchy
tenant_hierarchy.description: Parent–child tenant relationships with feature toggling and federation scoping.

smart_matching.title: Smart Matching
smart_matching.description: AI-powered matching with semantic embeddings, collaborative filtering, availability scheduling, and learned preferences.

real_time_messaging.title: Real-Time Messaging
real_time_messaging.description: Private conversations with Pusher WebSocket integration and real-time presence.

progressive_web_app.title: Progressive Web App
progressive_web_app.description: Install as a PWA on any device — offline shell, push notifications, NetworkFirst update flow.

native_mobile_app.title: Native Mobile App
native_mobile_app.description: A separate app built with Expo and React Native, talking to the same API as the website. One codebase produces both the Android and the iOS build.
native_mobile_app.note: The web app is still the main way in, and neither store build is published yet. Android is closest: signing, build profiles and push notifications are all in place. iOS is built from the same code but additionally needs an Apple developer account and App Store review, so it will follow.

accessible_frontend.title: Accessible Frontend
accessible_frontend.description: A second, separate frontend built on GOV.UK Frontend for members who want a plain, HTML-first experience that keeps working without JavaScript. It runs on its own web address and reads the same API as the main app.
accessible_frontend.note: Live today. Every page in the main app has a matching accessible page, but each one is still being checked against the main app behaviour by behaviour, which is why it carries a Beta label rather than GA.

explore_discovery.title: Discover
explore_discovery.description: One curated page that surfaces skills, listings, events, groups, posts and people worth seeing, so members do not have to hunt through every section to find them.

maps_and_location.title: Maps & Location Providers
maps_and_location.description: Mapping and address lookup are pluggable per community: Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, or Ordnance Survey tiles, paired with Google Places, Nominatim, or UPRN-backed OS Places address validation. Maps stay switched off until a community turns them on, so no mapping key ever reaches the browser by default.

federation.title: Federation
federation.intro: Federation means two different things here, and they are at different stages. Connecting communities that live on one installation is in everyday use. Connecting to other installations and other platforms is built and tested, but switched off by default and not currently in use.

federation_network.title: Community Network (same installation)
federation_network.description: Link multiple communities hosted on one installation for cross-community discovery, listings, events, and messaging.

external_partner_federation.title: External Partner Federation
external_partner_federation.description: Connect to other NEXUS installations and to other timebanking platforms over four documented protocols: Nexus native, Komunitin, Credit Commons (CEN-compatible), and TimeOverflow.
external_partner_federation.note: Complete and tested, and switched off by default — every external endpoint answers with a temporarily-unavailable response until an operator enables it. No external partner is connected today. Other platform operators have expressed interest, so the groundwork is in place and audited, but we are not developing it further until a concrete integration is on the table. If you want to federate with us, get in touch.

multi_protocol_adapters.title: Multi-Protocol Adapters
multi_protocol_adapters.description: Adapters for two-way sync of 9 entity types — members, listings, events, groups, connections, volunteering, reviews, transfers, messages — across all four protocols.
multi_protocol_adapters.note: Built and covered by tests alongside External Partner Federation, and dormant for the same reason: nothing is switched on, so nothing is syncing.

federation_neighborhoods.title: Federation Neighborhoods
federation_neighborhoods.description: Geographically grouped clusters of linked communities for regional coordination.

credit_agreements.title: Credit Agreements
credit_agreements.description: Negotiated exchange-rate terms between linked communities.

federation_analytics.title: Federation Analytics
federation_analytics.description: Admin dashboards for cross-community activity, sync health, and federated transaction volume.

partner_network_portal.title: Network & Partner Portal
partner_network_portal.description: A dedicated area for whoever runs a network of communities rather than a single one: a partner directory, neighbourhood grouping, credit agreements, network-wide settings, combined activity and analytics, data management, and API keys with their own documentation.
partner_network_portal.note: The parts that reach other installations — external partners, inbound API partners and Credit Commons — stay switched off with the rest of external federation. The internal network tooling is in everyday use.

service_listings.title: Service Listings
service_listings.description: Post offers and requests, browse and smart-match listings.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: A separate classifieds module for goods and paid services: seller profiles and onboarding, orders and sales, Stripe Connect payouts, a free-and-giveaway section, collections, a map view, pickup slots with QR scanning, shipping options, seller coupons, case handling for disputes, and AI-suggested replies.

donations.title: Donations
donations.description: One-off and recurring donations via Stripe with full dashboards and receipts for organisations.

identity_verification.title: Identity Verification
identity_verification.description: Optional Stripe Identity flow (document + selfie + name/DOB matching) with a verified-member badge.

exchange_workflow.title: Exchange Workflow
exchange_workflow.description: Structured service-exchange lifecycle with broker approval and dispute handling.

group_exchanges.title: Group Exchanges
group_exchanges.description: Bulk community service exchanges across multiple members.

social_feed.title: Social Feed
social_feed.description: Posts, comments, likes, polls, hashtags, voice messages, media attachments, link previews, and @mentions.

stories.title: Stories
stories.description: Ephemeral 24-hour photo and video stories with reactions, polls, and highlights.

presence_system.title: Presence System
presence_system.description: Real-time online/offline status with privacy controls and custom status messages.

events_and_groups.title: Events & Groups
events_and_groups.description: Community gatherings and interest-based groups, with invitations, membership rules, reminders, and group discussion.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Follow and connect with other community members.

members_directory.title: Members Directory
members_directory.description: Browse, filter, and discover people in your community.

gamification.title: Gamification
gamification.description: Verification badges, journeys, XP, leaderboards, achievements, challenges, streaks, XP shop rewards, community dashboard, and seasonal competitions.

goals_and_impact.title: Goals & Impact
goals_and_impact.description: Track personal goals and community impact with mentoring and deliverables tracking.

ideation_challenges.title: Ideation Challenges
ideation_challenges.description: Innovation hub with campaigns, ideas, voting, and outcomes tracking.

volunteering.title: Volunteering
volunteering.description: Volunteer opportunities, hours tracking, check-ins, expenses, certificates, wellbeing monitoring, emergency alerts, and a volunteer-organisation wallet that pays out time credits on approved hours.

job_vacancies.title: Job Vacancies
job_vacancies.description: A full recruitment module: vacancies and applications, a drag-and-drop hiring pipeline, talent search, employer profiles and branding, employer onboarding, saved job alerts, per-vacancy analytics, and a public RSS and JSON feed so job aggregators can pick postings up.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.description: Company and employer profiles with sub-accounts and a dedicated organisation wallet.

sub_accounts_family_accounts.title: Sub-Accounts / Family Accounts
sub_accounts_family_accounts.description: Parent–child account relationships for household and family management.

reviews_and_ratings.title: Reviews & Ratings
reviews_and_ratings.description: Build trust through structured member feedback.

polls.title: Polls
polls.description: Community voting and surveys with multiple question types.

skills_browse.title: Skills Browse
skills_browse.description: Explore the skill taxonomy and discover expertise.

availability_scheduling.title: Availability Scheduling
availability_scheduling.description: Timezone-aware time-slot scheduling for smart matching and bookings.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Community learning: members run courses with lessons and quizzes, other members enrol and work through them, and instructors can grade work, see how a course is doing, and issue a certificate at the end.

podcasts.title: Podcasts & Community Audio
podcasts.description: Community shows, audio stories, interviews and local knowledge recorded by members, with episodes, transcripts, chapters, moderation, and a public RSS feed that works in ordinary podcast apps.

clubs_and_associations.title: Clubs & Associations
clubs_and_associations.description: Membership handling for clubs and associations: dues tracking, bulk member import, and invitations that work across linked clubs.

public_events.title: Public Events
public_events.description: Let people without an account browse and read published events. Signing up for one still needs a login.

event_attendance_credits.title: Attendance Rewards
event_attendance_credits.description: Award time credits on verified event check-in, minted against the community rather than taken from the host, so running an event is never a personal cost.
event_attendance_credits.note: Switched off by default, and the switch alone cannot move credits: an operator must also enable treasury minting and set a per-event amount.

partner_venues.title: Partner Venues
partner_venues.description: Record member visits at local partner venues by scanning the member’s pass QR code. It records the visit only — the platform issues no coupon and applies no discount.

collections_and_bookmarks.title: Collections & Saved Items
collections_and_bookmarks.description: Save listings, members and posts, and group them into collections you can share with other members.

guardian_consent.title: Guardian Consent
guardian_consent.description: Guardian approval for a minor volunteer or event attendee: single-use consent links, encrypted guardian details, and a consent history that can only be added to, never edited.
guardian_consent.note: Project NEXUS is for adults — signing up requires confirming you are 18 or older. This is for communities that run supervised activity with young people, where a coordinator sets the account up. It is switched off unless a community turns it on.

member_premium.title: Donations & Support
member_premium.description: Members can give a one-off donation, or set up a regular one, to support the community that runs their timebank, and manage or stop it themselves at any time. Supporters are recognised for it — this is not a paid tier, and no part of the platform is ever put behind a payment.

event_operations.title: Event Operations
event_operations.description: Everything needed to actually run an event: ticketing and registration, waiting lists, blueprints for recurring events, an agenda with speakers, QR check-in that keeps working when the signal drops, accessibility details, safety notes, attendee messaging, reusable templates, per-event analytics, and a full history of every change.

merchant_coupons.title: Merchant Coupons
merchant_coupons.description: Discount coupons issued by marketplace merchants. Kept deliberately separate from spending time credits, and it needs the Marketplace switched on as well.

hiring_bias_audit.title: Hiring Bias Audit
hiring_bias_audit.description: Process analytics that surface possible bias in a community’s own hiring: how candidates progress through each stage, rejection rates and average time per stage, how strongly a skills match actually predicts the outcome, and which application sources succeed.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Tenant-managed content management and community news.

resources_and_knowledge_base.title: Resources & Knowledge Base
resources_and_knowledge_base.description: Structured articles and a shared resource library.

custom_pages.title: Custom Pages
custom_pages.description: Tenant-managed CMS pages for community content.

newsletter_system.title: Newsletter System
newsletter_system.description: Email campaign manager with A/B testing, smart segments, geo targeting, recurring sends, templates, send-time optimisation, and full open/click analytics.

legal_hub.title: Legal Hub
legal_hub.description: Versioned legal documents with acceptance gates and audit trail.

impact_reports.title: Impact Reports
impact_reports.description: SROI analysis, member outcome reports, and social impact case studies.

social_prescribing.title: Social Prescribing Partnership
social_prescribing.description: A managed pathway for health services to refer patients into the timebank as community support. A GP, social prescriber or community health worker makes a formal referral — there is no self-referral hurdle — then a coordinator personally welcomes the person, builds a profile around their strengths, matches them to exchanges, groups and events, and checks in regularly, sending outcome data back to whoever referred them. The page sets out the published results, including a 16:1 social return, and how the model lines up with Sláintecare and the HSE Social Prescribing Framework.
social_prescribing.note: This is one community’s live programme, presented for health and public-sector partners to read — it is a referral pathway run by people, not a switch another community can turn on, and the platform holds no referral form of its own. If you would like to build something similar with us, get in touch.

message_translation.title: Message Translation
message_translation.description: A toggle in any conversation that automatically translates direct messages between two members who do not share a language.

member_verification_badges.title: Member Verification Badges
member_verification_badges.description: Verified status indicators on member profiles.

streaks.title: Streaks
streaks.description: Consecutive activity tracking to reward consistent engagement.

personal_insights_dashboard.title: Personal Insights Dashboard
personal_insights_dashboard.description: Individual engagement metrics, hours given/received, skills breakdown, monthly charts, and personalised recommendations.

safeguarding_module.title: Safeguarding Module
safeguarding_module.description: Flagged content review workflow, incident reporting, safeguarding assignment tracking, and a community safety dashboard.

crm.title: CRM
crm.description: Admin contact management with notes, tasks, tags, activity timelines, and export.

broker_application.title: Broker & Coordinator Application
broker_application.description: A separate application for the coordinators and brokers who step in between members when a safeguarding or compliance concern is live. It holds exchange oversight and match approval, member records and onboarding progress, moderation queues for the feed, comments and reviews, risk tags and watch lists, message review for members placed under monitoring, insurance certificate tracking, and reporting.
broker_application.note: A broker is an operational role in its own right, not a junior administrator: brokers get this application and are deliberately refused the general admin panel.

two_factor_and_passkeys.title: Two-Factor Login & Passkeys
two_factor_and_passkeys.description: An authenticator-app second factor, and passkeys through Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID or a hardware security key, so a member can sign in without typing a password at all. Each is switchable per community.

semantic_search.title: Semantic Search
semantic_search.description: Meilisearch-powered full-text search across listings, members, events, and groups with typo tolerance, synonyms, and per-tenant isolation.

collaborative_filtering.title: Collaborative Filtering
collaborative_filtering.description: Item-based recommendations from real community interaction data.

semantic_embeddings.title: Semantic Embeddings
semantic_embeddings.description: OpenAI-powered content matching for listings, members, and requests.

edgerank_feed.title: EdgeRank Feed
edgerank_feed.description: Time-decay, affinity, and engagement-weighted feed ranking.

matchrank_and_communityrank.title: MatchRank & CommunityRank
matchrank_and_communityrank.description: Bayesian quality scoring with Wilson confidence intervals.

match_learning.title: Match Learning
match_learning.description: Feedback loop that improves recommendations from user interactions.

algorithm_health_dashboard.title: Algorithm Health Dashboard
algorithm_health_dashboard.description: Live admin monitoring and tuning of all ranking systems.

ai_agents.title: AI Agents
ai_agents.description: Per-community AI agents that run jobs on a schedule, put proposed actions in front of an administrator for approval, and help with day-to-day platform operations. Every run and every proposal is recorded.
ai_agents.note: Built and switched off by default. No community has it turned on today.

ai_provider_choice.title: Choice of AI Provider
ai_provider_choice.description: The AI layer is not tied to one vendor: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and self-hosted Ollama are all supported behind the same interface, so a community can pick on cost, data location, or policy grounds.

caring_community_layer.title: Caring Community Layer
caring_community_layer.intro: An integrated mutual-aid layer that brings everyday care, volunteering, organisations and impact together. It stays switched off until a community opts in, and the admin panel labels it Alpha, so everything here carries a Preview chip.

civic_digest.title: Civic Digest
civic_digest.description: Periodic summary of community activity and outcomes for stakeholders.

success_stories.title: Success Stories
success_stories.description: Curated case studies of member-led outcomes.

feedback_inbox.title: Feedback Inbox
feedback_inbox.description: Centralised pilot-feedback capture with admin triage.

integration_showcase.title: Integration Showcase
integration_showcase.description: Public surface for connected partners and integrations.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.description: In-context AI helper for community administrators.

request_help.title: Request Help & Offer Favours
request_help.description: Tell your neighbours what you need without writing a formal listing, or record an informal act of kindness you have already done. A favour needs no time credits — it simply gets recognised.

care_relationships.title: Care Relationships
care_relationships.description: Link yourself to someone you are informally caring for, see everyone in your care in one place, arrange temporary cover when you need respite or are away, and pause or end a relationship without losing its history.

hour_gifting_and_transfer.title: Gifting, Transfers & Future Care
hour_gifting_and_transfer.description: Gift banked hours to family, friends or anyone who needs them; take your banked hours with you if you move to another community running NEXUS; or leave them in a future care fund to draw on for grocery runs, appointments, or simply company, later on.

warmth_pass.title: Warmth Pass
warmth_pass.description: A portable trust credential a member earns on reaching Trusted tier, showing their logged hours, peer reviews, identity verification and the areas they help with. Members show it to care recipients, coordinators and organisations as proof that they are a trusted helper.

trust_tiers.title: Trust Tiers
trust_tiers.description: A member’s standing in the community, with a plain breakdown of how they earned their current tier and what the next one asks for.

care_providers.title: Care Provider Directory
care_providers.description: Find local care services, day centres, associations and volunteers in your region alongside member-to-member help.

safeguarding_reporting.title: Concern Reporting
safeguarding_reporting.description: Members can raise a safeguarding concern themselves, and staff review, assign and resolve it against an action log that can only be added to, never rewritten.

surveys_and_projects.title: Surveys & Community Projects
surveys_and_projects.description: Collect structured feedback from residents, municipal partners and programme teams, and coordinate community projects with the people taking part.

municipality_reporting.title: Municipality Reporting
municipality_reporting.description: A shared municipal calendar, a resident feedback inbox that routes questions, ideas, issues and complaints to the right team, and reporting built for council and public-sector partners.

community_market.title: Community Market
community_market.description: One place to discover time-credit services and local goods offered inside the community.

time_credit_redemption.title: Spending Time Credits Locally
time_credit_redemption.description: Members see the hours they have earned and spend them at taking-part local businesses, with a history of every redemption.

enterprise_security.title: Enterprise Security
enterprise_security.description: CSRF, rate limiting, TOTP 2FA, WebAuthn passkeys, CSP nonces, a CORS allowlist, Form Request validation, email verification gates, and invite-code registration.

stripe_payments_layer.title: Stripe Payments Layer
stripe_payments_layer.description: Subscriptions, donations, marketplace (Connect), and identity verification, with idempotent webhook handling and deep money-flow test coverage.

gdpr_compliance_suite.title: GDPR Compliance Suite
gdpr_compliance_suite.description: Data requests, consent management, cookie consent, breach tracking, and a full audit log.

fraud_and_abuse_detection.title: Fraud & Abuse Detection
fraud_and_abuse_detection.description: Automated suspicious-activity alerts and content moderation.

enterprise_rbac.title: Enterprise RBAC
enterprise_rbac.description: Role-based access control across 13+ modules with a full permission matrix.

wcag_2_1_aa_accessibility.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
wcag_2_1_aa_accessibility.description: Audited accessibility compliance across the user-facing surface.

multi_language_support.title: Multi-Language Support
multi_language_support.description: 11 languages: English, Irish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, Polish, Japanese, and Arabic (full RTL).

self_hosted_prerendering.title: Self-Hosted Prerendering
self_hosted_prerendering.description: Bot-only Playwright snapshots served to SEO crawlers; users always get the live SPA.

guided_onboarding.title: Guided Onboarding
guided_onboarding.description: Wizard for new members with smart defaults.

admin_panel.title: Admin Panel
admin_panel.description: Algorithm controls, diagnostics, cron-job monitoring, and email-deliverability monitoring.

email_webhook_processing.title: Email Webhook Processing
email_webhook_processing.description: Postmark bounce, complaint, open, and delivery event handling.

openapi_3_0_specification.title: OpenAPI 3.0 Specification
openapi_3_0_specification.description: Full API spec with Swagger UI docs.

fully_dockerized.title: Fully Dockerized
fully_dockerized.description: Production and development run from the same Docker Compose foundations.

automated_test_suite.title: Automated Test Suite
automated_test_suite.description: Around 16,500 PHP test methods across 1,600 test files, plus roughly 1,300 frontend test suites, covering money flow, webhooks, federation, groups and the marketplace. Every push runs them, and a deploy is blocked until the pushed commit has been checked.

performance_monitoring.title: Performance Monitoring
performance_monitoring.description: Every request is counted, and slow, memory-hungry or query-heavy requests are recorded in detail for an admin dashboard. Only the shape of a query is stored, never member data, and old records are pruned nightly.

partner_api_and_developer_portal.title: Partner API & Developer Portal
partner_api_and_developer_portal.description: A documented API that lets an external partner integrate with a community, with token authentication, an endpoint reference and webhooks, plus a self-serve developer portal for whoever is building the integration.
partner_api_and_developer_portal.note: Built and switched off by default. No external partner is using it today.

local_advertising.title: Local Advertising
local_advertising.description: Community-run advertising and push campaigns with their own budgeting and admin tooling, so a community can promote local activity itself.
local_advertising.note: Built and switched off by default.

swiss_fadp_mode.title: Swiss FADP Mode
swiss_fadp_mode.description: An additional consent banner and data-handling mode for communities operating under the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection.
swiss_fadp_mode.note: Built and switched off by default.

regional_analytics.title: Regional Analytics
regional_analytics.description: Monthly regional activity reports prepared for municipalities and regional bodies, managed centrally rather than by each community.
regional_analytics.note: Built and switched off by default.

community_onboarding.title: New Community Onboarding
community_onboarding.description: How a new community gets started: a public application form, a link that lets applicants follow their own progress, an enquiry route for questions first, and admin provisioning tools to stand the community up once it is approved.

en.maturity_dormant: Built, tested and switched off by default. The work is done and audited, but nothing is using it yet - we will develop it further when there is real demand.
en.availability_notice_title: Your community may not have all of these switched on
en.availability_notice_body: This page shows everything the Project NEXUS software can do. It is not a list of what is turned on for your own community.
en.availability_notice_body_2: Every community chooses which parts it wants to use, so some of the things listed below will not appear in your menus. That is normal and it is not a fault — it simply means your community has not switched that part on.
en.availability_notice_body_3: What you can actually use is whatever you can see in your own menus. If something here looks useful and you cannot find it, ask whoever runs your community to turn it on.
en.no_results_body: Try a shorter word, or choose Everything to bring the whole list back.

ga.title: Gnéithe
ga.meta_description: Gach modúl atá ar fáil in Project NEXUS v1.6, le lipéid mhacánta aibíochta don bhaincéireacht ama, don chónaidhm, don fhoghlaim, don mhargadh, don chúram pobail, don tsábháilteacht, don anailísíocht agus don bhonneagar foinse oscailte.
ga.heading: Cad a dhéanann Project NEXUS
ga.subheading: Is ardán pobail iltionónta ar chaighdeán fiontair é Project NEXUS. Tá gach modúl thíos ar fáil in v2.0.0 anois. Cuirimid lipéid mhacánta ar a n-aibíocht: tá míreanna gan lipéad ar fáil go ginearálta; bíonn lipéad Béite nó Réamhamhairc ar ghnéithe níos nuaí nó ar ghnéithe atá fós á ndaingniú; agus ciallaíonn Tógtha, gan a bheith cumasaithe go bhfuil an obair críochnaithe ach múchta go dtí go mbeidh gá léi.
ga.maturity_ga: Ar fáil go ginearálta - cobhsaí, tacaithe, in úsáid i dtáirgeadh ar fud na dtionóntaí píolótacha.
ga.maturity_beta: Ag obair i dtáirgeadh anois, ach tá an comhéadan poiblí nó an prótacal cumarsáide fós á dhaingniú.
ga.maturity_preview: Eisithe le déanaí agus ar fáil más mian leat é a chumasú. Beidh athruithe tapa ann — d'fhéadfadh an API agus an t-eispéireas úsáideora athrú.
ga.open_source_body: Tá Project NEXUS go hiomlán foinse oscailte faoi AGPL-3.0. Is féidir gach líne den chód a iniúchadh, a fhorcáil agus a fhéinóstáil. Tá na prótacail chónaidhme doiciméadaithe mar chaighdeáin oscailte ionas nach mbeidh aon ardán amháin i gceannas ar an líonra domhanda banc ama.
ga.security_body_before: An bhfuair tú saincheist slándála? Tuairiscigh go príobháideach í chuig
ga.security_body_after: seachas saincheist phoiblí a chomhdú. Tá an beartas iomlán um nochtadh leochaileachtaí in SECURITY.md sa stór cód foinseach.

tech_stack.ai_value: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, agus tacaíocht do Anthropic, Google Gemini agus Ollama féinóstáilte tríd an gcomhéadan céanna
tech_stack.frontend_value: React 19 + TypeScript + HeroUI v3 + Tailwind CSS 4, tógtha le Vite 7
tech_stack.mobile_value: Expo / React Native (Android réidh lena eisiúint, iOS ar feitheamh)
tech_stack.accessible_value: GOV.UK Frontend 6.4 + Express + Nunjucks, HTML ar dtús agus oibríonn sé gan JavaScript

timebanking_engine.title: Inneall Baincéireachta Ama
timebanking_engine.description: Córas iomlán malartaithe creidmheasa le sparán, idirbhearta agus rialuithe bróicéara.

multi_tenancy.title: Iltionóntacht
multi_tenancy.description: Óstáil líon ar bith pobal ar ardán amháin, agus a bhrandáil, a chumraíocht agus a shraith gnéithe féin ag gach pobal.

tenant_hierarchy.title: Ordlathas tionóntaí
tenant_hierarchy.description: Caidreamh tuismitheoir–leanbh idir tionóntaí le scoránú gnéithe agus scóip chónaidhme.

smart_matching.title: Meaitseáil chliste
smart_matching.description: Meaitseáil chumhachtaithe ag IS le leabuithe séimeantacha, scagadh comhoibríoch, sceidealú infhaighteachta agus sainroghanna foghlamtha.

real_time_messaging.title: Teachtaireachtaí fíor-ama
real_time_messaging.description: Comhráite príobháideacha le comhtháthú Pusher WebSocket agus láithreacht fíor-ama.

progressive_web_app.title: Feidhmchlár gréasáin forásach
progressive_web_app.description: Suiteáil mar PWA ar aon ghléas — sliogán as líne, fógraí brú, sreabhadh nuashonraithe NetworkFirst.

native_mobile_app.title: Aip dhúchasach soghluaiste
native_mobile_app.description: Aip ar leith a tógadh le Expo agus React Native, agus a úsáideann an API céanna leis an suíomh gréasáin. Cruthaítear leagan Android agus leagan iOS ón mbunachar cód céanna.
native_mobile_app.note: Is í an aip gréasáin an príomhbhealach isteach fós, agus níl ceachtar den dá leagan siopa foilsithe go fóill. Is é Android is gaire don eisiúint: tá síniú, próifílí tógála agus fógraí brú socraithe. Tógtar iOS ón gcód céanna, ach teastaíonn cuntas forbróra Apple agus athbhreithniú san App Store freisin, mar sin tiocfaidh sé ina dhiaidh.

accessible_frontend.title: Comhéadan Inrochtana
accessible_frontend.description: Comhéadan ar leith eile atá tógtha ar GOV.UK Frontend do bhaill ar mhaith leo taithí shimplí, HTML ar dtús, a leanann ag obair gan JavaScript. Ritheann sé ar a sheoladh gréasáin féin agus léann sé an API céanna leis an bpríomhaip.
accessible_frontend.note: Beo anois. Tá leathanach inrochtana comhfhreagrach ag gach leathanach sa phríomhaip, ach tá gach ceann díobh fós á sheiceáil gné i ndiaidh gné i gcomparáid leis an bpríomhaip — sin an fáth a bhfuil lipéad Béite air seachas Ar Fáil go Ginearálta.

explore_discovery.title: Faigh Amach
explore_discovery.description: Leathanach coimeádta amháin a chuireann scileanna, liostálacha, imeachtaí, grúpaí, postálacha agus daoine spéisiúla os comhair an bhaill, ionas nach gá dóibh gach rannóg a chuardach chun iad a aimsiú.

maps_and_location.title: Mapaí agus Soláthraithe Suímh
maps_and_location.description: Is féidir soláthraí mapála agus cuardaigh seoltaí a roghnú do gach pobal: Google Maps, OpenStreetMap nó tíleanna Ordnance Survey, in éineacht le fíorú seoltaí ó Google Places, Nominatim nó OS Places bunaithe ar UPRN. Fanann mapaí múchta go dtí go gcumasaíonn pobal iad, mar sin ní sheoltar eochair mhapála chuig an mbrabhsálaí de réir réamhshocraithe.

federation.title: Cónaidhm
federation.intro: Tá dhá bhrí éagsúla le cónaidhm anseo, agus tá siad ag céimeanna éagsúla. Úsáidtear an nasc idir pobail ar an tsuiteáil chéanna gach lá. Tá naisc le suiteálacha agus ardáin eile tógtha agus tástáilte, ach tá siad múchta de réir réamhshocraithe agus níl siad in úsáid faoi láthair.

federation_network.title: Líonra Pobail (suiteáil chéanna)
federation_network.description: Nasc pobail éagsúla atá á n-óstáil ar shuiteáil amháin chun liostálacha, imeachtaí agus teachtaireachtaí a aimsiú thar phobail éagsúla.

external_partner_federation.title: Cónaidhm le páirtithe seachtracha
external_partner_federation.description: Ceangail le suiteálacha NEXUS eile agus le hardáin eile baincéireachta ama trí cheithre phrótacal doiciméadaithe: Nexus Native, Komunitin, Credit Commons (comhoiriúnach le CEN) agus TimeOverflow.
external_partner_federation.note: Tá sé críochnaithe agus tástáilte, agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe — tugann gach críochphointe seachtrach freagra sealadach nach bhfuil sé ar fáil go dtí go gcumasaíonn oibreoir é. Níl aon chomhpháirtí seachtrach nasctha faoi láthair. Tá spéis léirithe ag oibreoirí ardán eile, mar sin tá an bhunobair déanta agus iniúchta, ach ní fhorbróimid tuilleadh í go dtí go mbeidh togra comhtháthaithe sonrach ann. Más mian leat dul i gcónaidhm linn, déan teagmháil linn.

multi_protocol_adapters.title: Cuibheoirí ilphrótacal
multi_protocol_adapters.description: Cuibheoirí chun naoi gcineál eintitis a shioncronú sa dá threo — baill, liostálacha, imeachtaí, grúpaí, naisc, obair dheonach, léirmheasanna, aistrithe agus teachtaireachtaí — thar na ceithre phrótacal.
multi_protocol_adapters.note: Tógtha agus clúdaithe ag tástálacha in éineacht le Cónaidhm na gComhpháirtithe Seachtracha, agus díomhaoin ar an gcúis chéanna: níl aon cheann de na naisc cumasaithe, mar sin níl aon sioncronú ar siúl.

federation_neighborhoods.title: Comharsanachtaí cónaidhme
federation_neighborhoods.description: Cnuasaigh de phobail nasctha atá grúpáilte go geografach le haghaidh comhordú réigiúnach.

credit_agreements.title: Comhaontuithe creidmheasa
credit_agreements.description: Téarmaí ráta malairte idirbheartaithe idir pobail nasctha.

federation_analytics.title: Anailísíocht chónaidhme
federation_analytics.description: Deais riaracháin le haghaidh gníomhaíochta idirphobail, sláinte sioncronaithe agus líon na n-idirbheart idirphobail.

partner_network_portal.title: Tairseach Líonra agus Páirtithe
partner_network_portal.description: Limistéar ar leith dóibh siúd a reáchtálann líonra pobal seachas aon phobal amháin: eolaire comhpháirtithe, grúpáil comharsanachtaí, comhaontuithe creidmheasa, socruithe don líonra ar fad, gníomhaíocht agus anailísíocht chomhcheangailte, bainistiú sonraí, agus eochracha API lena ndoiciméadacht féin.
partner_network_portal.note: Fanann na codanna a shroicheann suiteálacha eile — páirtithe seachtracha, páirtithe API isteach agus Credit Commons — múchta in éineacht le cuid eile na cónaidhme seachtraí. Tá uirlisí an líonra inmheánaigh in úsáid go laethúil.

service_listings.title: Liostálacha Seirbhísí
service_listings.description: Foilsigh tairiscintí agus iarrataí, brabhsáil liostálacha agus meaitseáil iad go cliste.

marketplace.title: Margadh
marketplace.description: Modúl fógraí rangaithe ar leith d’earraí agus do sheirbhísí íoctha: próifílí agus ionduchtú díoltóirí, orduithe agus díolacháin, eisíocaíochtaí Stripe Connect, rannóg d’earraí saor in aisce agus bronntanais, cnuasaigh, amharc mapa, sliotáin bhailithe le scanadh QR, roghanna loingseoireachta, cúpóin díoltóirí, láimhseáil díospóidí agus freagraí molta ag an intleacht shaorga.

donations.title: Síntiúis
donations.description: Síntiúis aon-uaire agus athfhillteacha trí Stripe le painéil iomlána agus admhálacha d'eagraíochtaí.

identity_verification.title: Fíorú aitheantais
identity_verification.description: Sreabhadh roghnach Stripe Identity (doiciméad, féinín agus meaitseáil ainm agus dáta breithe) le suaitheantas ball fíoraithe.

exchange_workflow.title: Sreabhadh oibre malartaithe
exchange_workflow.description: Saolré struchtúrtha malartaithe seirbhíse le ceadú bróicéara agus láimhseáil aighnis.

group_exchanges.title: Malartuithe grúpa
group_exchanges.description: Malartuithe seirbhíse pobail ar an mórchóir idir roinnt ball.

social_feed.title: Fotha sóisialta
social_feed.description: Postálacha, tráchtanna, rudaí a thaitníonn le daoine, pobalbhreitheanna, haischlibeanna, teachtaireachtaí gutha, ceangaltáin meán, réamhamhairc nasc agus @lua.

stories.title: Scéalta
stories.description: Scéalta neamhbhuana grianghraf agus físeáin a mhaireann 24 uair, le frithghníomhartha, pobalbhreitheanna agus buaicphointí.

presence_system.title: Córas láithreachta
presence_system.description: Stádas ar líne/as líne fíor-ama le rialuithe príobháideachta agus teachtaireachtaí stádais saincheaptha.

events_and_groups.title: Imeachtaí agus Grúpaí
events_and_groups.description: Cruinnithe comhphobail agus grúpaí bunaithe ar spéiseanna, le cuirí, rialacha ballraíochta, meabhrúcháin, agus plé grúpa.

connections.title: Naisc
connections.description: Lean baill eile den phobal agus déan nasc leo.

members_directory.title: Eolaire ball
members_directory.description: Brabhsáil, scag agus aimsigh daoine i do phobal.

gamification.title: Cluichíocht
gamification.description: Suaitheantais fíoraithe, aistir, XP, cláir cheannairí, éachtaí, dúshláin, stráicí, duaiseanna ón siopa XP, painéal pobail agus comórtais shéasúracha.

goals_and_impact.title: Spriocanna agus tionchar
goals_and_impact.description: Rianaigh spriocanna pearsanta agus tionchar pobail, le meantóireacht agus rianú táirgí insoláthartha.

ideation_challenges.title: Dúshláin smaointeoireachta
ideation_challenges.description: Mol nuálaíochta le feachtais, smaointe, vótáil agus rianú torthaí.

volunteering.title: Obair dheonach
volunteering.description: Deiseanna oibre deonaí, rianú uaireanta, seiceáil isteach, costais, teastais, monatóireacht folláine, foláirimh éigeandála agus sparán d’eagraíochtaí deonacha a íocann creidmheasanna ama as uaireanta ceadaithe.

job_vacancies.title: Folúntais Poist
job_vacancies.description: Modúl earcaíochta iomlán: folúntais agus iarratais, píblíne earcaíochta tarraing-agus-scaoil, cuardach tallainne, próifílí agus brandáil fostóirí, ionduchtú fostóirí, foláirimh maidir le folúntais a shábháiltear, anailísíocht do gach folúntas, agus fothaí poiblí RSS agus JSON chun gur féidir le comhbhailitheoirí post na fógraí a bhailiú.

organisations.title: Eagraíochtaí
organisations.description: Próifílí cuideachtaí agus fostóirí le fochuntais agus sparán ar leith don eagraíocht.

sub_accounts_family_accounts.title: Fochuntais / Cuntais Teaghlaigh
sub_accounts_family_accounts.description: Caidrimh chuntais tuismitheoir–leanbh do bhainistíocht líon tí agus teaghlaigh.

reviews_and_ratings.title: Léirmheasanna agus Rátálacha
reviews_and_ratings.description: Tóg muinín trí aiseolas struchtúrtha ó bhaill.

endorsements.title: Formhuinithe
endorsements.description: Formhuinithe scileanna agus taithí ó phiaraí.

polls.title: Pobalbhreitheanna
polls.description: Vótáil agus suirbhéanna pobail le cineálacha éagsúla ceisteanna.

skills_browse.title: Brabhsáil scileanna
skills_browse.description: Scrúdaigh tacsanomaíocht na scileanna agus aimsigh daoine a bhfuil saineolas acu.

availability_scheduling.title: Sceidealú infhaighteachta
availability_scheduling.description: Sceidealú sliotán a chuireann criosanna ama san áireamh le haghaidh meaitseáil chliste agus áirithintí.

courses.title: Cúrsaí
courses.description: Foghlaim phobail: reáchtálann baill cúrsaí ina bhfuil ceachtanna agus tráth na gceist, cláraíonn baill eile agus déanann siad dul chun cinn tríothu, agus is féidir le teagascóirí obair a ghrádú, monatóireacht a dhéanamh ar dhul chun cinn an chúrsa agus teastas a eisiúint ag an deireadh.

podcasts.title: Podchraoltaí agus Fuaim Chomhphobail
podcasts.description: Seónna comhphobail, scéalta fuaime, agallaimh agus eolas áitiúil taifeadta ag baill, le heipeasóidí, tras-scríbhinní, caibidlí, modhnóireacht, agus fotha RSS poiblí a oibríonn i ngnáthaipeanna podchraolta.

clubs_and_associations.title: Clubanna agus Cumainn
clubs_and_associations.description: Bainistiú ballraíochta do chlubanna agus cumainn: rianú táillí, iompórtáil bhall ina mbaisc, agus cuirí a oibríonn thar chlubanna nasctha.

public_events.title: Imeachtaí Poiblí
public_events.description: Lig do dhaoine nach bhfuil cuntas acu imeachtaí foilsithe a bhrabhsáil agus a léamh. Ní mór síniú isteach fós chun clárú d’imeacht.

event_attendance_credits.title: Luaíochtaí Freastail
event_attendance_credits.description: Bronn creidmheasanna ama nuair a fhíoraítear seiceáil isteach ag imeacht. Eisítear iad ó chuntas an phobail seachas iad a bhaint den óstach, mar sin ní ghearrtar costas pearsanta ar an té a reáchtálann an t-imeacht.
event_attendance_credits.note: Múchta de réir réamhshocraithe, agus ní féidir leis an lasc amháin creidmheasanna a aistriú: ní mór d’oibreoir eisiúint creidmheasanna ón gciste a chumasú agus méid a shocrú do gach imeacht freisin.

partner_venues.title: Ionaid Chomhpháirtíochta
partner_venues.description: Taifead cuairteanna ball ar ionaid chomhpháirtíochta áitiúla trí chód QR phas an bhaill a scanadh. Ní thaifeadtar ach an chuairt — ní eisíonn an t-ardán cúpón ná ní chuireann sé lascaine i bhfeidhm.

collections_and_bookmarks.title: Cnuasaigh agus Míreanna Sábháilte
collections_and_bookmarks.description: Sábháil liostálacha, baill agus postálacha, agus grúpáil iad i gcnuasaigh is féidir leat a roinnt le baill eile.

guardian_consent.title: Toiliú Caomhnóra
guardian_consent.description: Ceadú caomhnóra do dhuine óg atá ag obair go deonach nó ag freastal ar imeacht: naisc toilithe aon-úsáide, sonraí caomhnóra criptithe, agus stair toilithe nach féidir ach cur léi, riamh a chur in eagar.
guardian_consent.note: Ardán do dhaoine fásta is é Project NEXUS — ní mór dearbhú go bhfuil tú 18 nó níos sine chun clárú. Tá sé seo do phobail a reáchtálann gníomhaíochtaí faoi mhaoirseacht le daoine óga, áit a gcuireann comhordaitheoir an cuntas ar bun. Tá sé múchta mura gcuireann pobal ar siúl é.

member_premium.title: Síntiúis agus Tacaíocht
member_premium.description: Is féidir le baill síntiús aonuaire a thabhairt nó síntiús rialta a shocrú chun tacú leis an bpobal a reáchtálann a mbanc ama, agus is féidir leo é a bhainistiú nó a stopadh am ar bith. Tugtar aitheantas dá lucht tacaíochta — ní leibhéal íoctha é seo, agus ní chuirtear aon chuid den ardán faoi ghlas taobh thiar de bhalla íocaíochta.

event_operations.title: Oibríochtaí Imeachtaí
event_operations.description: Gach rud atá riachtanach chun imeacht a reáchtáil i ndáiríre: ticéadú agus clárú, liostaí feithimh, treoirphleananna d’imeachtaí athfhillteacha, clár oibre le cainteoirí, seiceáil isteach QR a leanann ag obair nuair a thiteann an comhartha, sonraí inrochtaineachta, nótaí sábháilteachta, teachtaireachtaí chuig lucht freastail, teimpléid inathúsáidte, anailísíocht in aghaidh an imeachta, agus stair iomlán gach athraithe.

merchant_coupons.title: Cúpóin Trádálaithe
merchant_coupons.description: Cúpóin lascaine a eisíonn trádálaithe an mhargaidh. Coinnítear iad d’aon ghnó ar leithligh ó chreidmheasanna ama a chaitheamh, agus ní mór an Margadh a bheith cumasaithe freisin.

hiring_bias_audit.title: Iniúchadh Claontachta Earcaíochta
hiring_bias_audit.description: Anailísíocht phróisis a nochtann claontacht fhéideartha in earcaíocht an phobail féin: conas a théann iarrthóirí trí gach céim, rátaí diúltaithe agus an meán-am i ngach céim, cé chomh cruinn is a thuarann meaitseáil scileanna an toradh, agus cé na foinsí iarratas is rathúla.

blog.title: Blag
blog.description: Bainistíocht ábhair agus nuacht pobail á riaradh ag an tionónta.

resources_and_knowledge_base.title: Acmhainní agus Bonn Eolais
resources_and_knowledge_base.description: Ailt struchtúrtha agus leabharlann acmhainní comhroinnte.

custom_pages.title: Leathanaigh shaincheaptha
custom_pages.description: Leathanaigh CMS á riaradh ag an tionónta d'ábhar pobail.

newsletter_system.title: Córas nuachtlitreach
newsletter_system.description: Bainisteoir feachtas ríomhphoist le tástáil A/B, deighleoga cliste, spriocdhíriú geografach, seoltaí athfhillteacha, teimpléid, barrfheabhsú an ama seolta agus anailísíocht iomlán ar oscailtí agus cliceálacha.

ai_chat.title: Comhrá IS
ai_chat.description: Cúntóir atá cumhachtaithe ag OpenAI chun treoir a thabhairt maidir leis an ardán.

legal_hub.title: Mol dlí
legal_hub.description: Doiciméid dhlíthiúla le leaganacha, ceanglais ghlactha agus rian iniúchta.

impact_reports.title: Tuarascálacha tionchair
impact_reports.description: Anailís SROI, tuarascálacha ar thorthaí na mball agus cás-staidéir ar thionchar sóisialta.

social_prescribing.title: Comhpháirtíocht Oideasachta Sóisialta
social_prescribing.description: Conair bhainistithe do sheirbhísí sláinte chun othair a atreorú chuig an mbanc ama le haghaidh tacaíocht phobail. Déanann dochtúir teaghlaigh, oideasóir sóisialta nó oibrí sláinte pobail atreorú foirmiúil — ní bhíonn bac ar fhéinatreorú — agus ansin cuireann comhordaitheoir fáilte phearsanta roimh an duine, cruthaíonn próifíl bunaithe ar a láidreachtaí, meaitseálann é le malartuithe, grúpaí agus imeachtaí, agus déanann teagmháil rialta leis. Seoltar sonraí na dtorthaí ar ais chuig an té a rinne an t-atreorú. Leagtar amach ar an leathanach na torthaí foilsithe, toradh sóisialta 16:1 ina measc, agus an chaoi a bhfuil an múnla ag teacht le Sláintecare agus le Creat Oideasachta Sóisialta FSS.
social_prescribing.note: Is clár beo de chuid pobal amháin é seo, curtha i láthair do chomhpháirtithe sláinte agus earnála poiblí — conair atreoraithe a bhainistíonn daoine atá ann, ní lasc is féidir le pobal eile a chumasú, agus níl foirm atreoraithe dá chuid féin ag an ardán. Más mian leat rud éigin cosúil leis a thógáil linn, déan teagmháil linn.

message_translation.title: Aistriúchán Teachtaireachtaí
message_translation.description: Lasc in aon chomhrá a aistríonn teachtaireachtaí díreacha go huathoibríoch idir dhá bhall nach bhfuil teanga i gcoiteann acu.

member_verification_badges.title: Suaitheantais fíoraithe ball
member_verification_badges.description: Táscairí stádais fíoraithe ar phróifílí ball.

nexusscore.title: Scór NexusScore
nexusscore.description: Córas dílsithe scórála ar chlú agus iontaofacht.

streaks.title: Stráicí
streaks.description: Rianú ar ghníomhaíocht as a chéile chun luach saothair a thabhairt as rannpháirtíocht chomhsheasmhach.

personal_insights_dashboard.title: Painéal Léargais Phearsanta
personal_insights_dashboard.description: Méadrachtaí rannpháirtíochta aonair, uaireanta tugtha/faighte, miondealú scileanna, cairteacha míosúla agus moltaí pearsantaithe.

safeguarding_module.title: Modúl cosanta
safeguarding_module.description: Próiseas athbhreithnithe d’ábhar a bhfuil bratach curtha leis, tuairisciú teagmhas, rianú sannachán cosanta agus painéal sábháilteachta pobail.

crm.title: CRM
crm.description: Bainistíocht teagmhála ar thaobh an riaracháin le nótaí, tascanna, clibeanna, amlínte gníomhaíochta agus easpórtáil.

broker_application.title: Feidhmchlár Bróicéirí agus Comhordaitheoirí
broker_application.description: Feidhmchlár ar leith do chomhordaitheoirí agus do bhróicéirí a dhéanann idirghabháil idir baill nuair a bhíonn imní ghníomhach maidir le cosaint nó comhlíonadh. Cuireann sé maoirseacht ar mhalartuithe agus ceadú meaitseálacha, taifid ball agus dul chun cinn ionduchtaithe, scuainí modhnóireachta don fhotha, do thráchtanna agus do léirmheasanna, clibeanna riosca agus liostaí faire, athbhreithniú teachtaireachtaí do bhaill atá faoi mhonatóireacht, rianú teastas árachais agus tuairisciú ar fáil.
broker_application.note: Is ról oibríochtúil ann féin é bróicéir, ní riarthóir sóisearach: faigheann bróicéirí an feidhmchlár seo agus ní thugtar rochtain dóibh d’aon ghnó ar an bpainéal riaracháin ginearálta.

two_factor_and_passkeys.title: Fíordheimhniú Dhá Fhachtóir agus Paseochracha
two_factor_and_passkeys.description: Dara fachtóir trí aip fíordheimhnithe, agus paseochracha trí Windows Hello, Touch ID, Face ID nó eochair shlándála chrua-earraí, ionas gur féidir le ball síniú isteach gan pasfhocal a chlóscríobh ar chor ar bith. Is féidir gach ceann acu a chumasú nó a dhíchumasú do gach pobal ar leith.

semantic_search.title: Cuardach séimeantach
semantic_search.description: Cuardach lántéacs atá cumhachtaithe ag Meilisearch thar liostálacha, baill, imeachtaí agus grúpaí, le lamháltas d’earráidí clóscríofa, comhchiallaigh agus aonrú do gach tionónta ar leith.

collaborative_filtering.title: Scagadh comhoibríoch
collaborative_filtering.description: Moltaí mírbhunaithe ó shonraí fíora idirghníomhaíochta pobail.

semantic_embeddings.title: Leabuithe séimeantacha
semantic_embeddings.description: Meaitseáil ábhair atá cumhachtaithe ag OpenAI do liostálacha, baill agus iarrataí.

edgerank_feed.title: Fotha EdgeRank
edgerank_feed.description: Rangú an fhotha de réir meath ama, comhghaoil agus rannpháirtíochta.

matchrank_and_communityrank.title: MatchRank agus CommunityRank
matchrank_and_communityrank.description: Scóráil cháilíochta Bháéisianach le heatraimh mhuiníne Wilson.

group_recommendations.title: Moltaí grúpa
group_recommendations.description: Aimsiú grúpaí bunaithe ar threochtaí agus ar chomhghaol.

match_learning.title: Foghlaim meaitseála
match_learning.description: Lúb aiseolais a fheabhsaíonn moltaí ó idirghníomhaíochtaí úsáideoirí.

algorithm_health_dashboard.title: Painéal Sláinte na nAlgartam
algorithm_health_dashboard.description: Monatóireacht bheo agus tiúnadh riaracháin ar na córais rangaithe go léir.

ai_agents.title: Gníomhairí IS
ai_agents.note: Tógtha agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe. Níl sé cumasaithe ag aon phobal faoi láthair.
ai_agents.description: Gníomhairí intleachta saorga do gach pobal a ritheann tascanna de réir sceidil, a chuireann gníomhartha molta faoi bhráid riarthóra lena gceadú agus a chuidíonn le hoibríochtaí laethúla an ardáin. Taifeadtar gach rith agus gach moladh.

ai_provider_choice.title: Rogha Soláthraí IS
ai_provider_choice.description: Níl an ciseal intleachta saorga ceangailte le soláthraí amháin: tacaítear le OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini agus Ollama féinóstáilte tríd an gcomhéadan céanna, mar sin is féidir le pobal roghnú de réir costais, shuíomh na sonraí nó an bheartais.

caring_community_layer.title: Ciseal Cúraim Phobail

civic_digest.title: Achoimre Chathartha
civic_digest.description: Achoimre thréimhsiúil ar ghníomhaíocht agus torthaí an phobail do pháirtithe leasmhara.

success_stories.title: Scéalta Ratha
success_stories.description: Cás-staidéir roghnaithe ar thorthaí faoi stiúir na mball.

feedback_inbox.title: Bosca Isteach Aiseolais
feedback_inbox.description: Bailiú lárnach aiseolais ón treoirthionscadal, le triáiseáil riaracháin.

integration_showcase.title: Taispeántas Comhtháthuithe
integration_showcase.description: Comhéadan poiblí do chomhpháirtithe nasctha agus dá gcomhtháthuithe.

lead_nurture.title: Cothú Teagmhálaithe Féideartha
lead_nurture.description: Uirlisí sreafa oibre chun obair leantach a dhéanamh le páirtithe leasmhara an treoirthionscadail.

copilot.title: Cúntóir Copilot
copilot.description: Cúntóir IS comhthéacsúil do riarthóirí pobail.

request_help.title: Iarr Cabhair agus Tairg Gar
request_help.description: Inis do do chomharsana cad atá uait gan liostáil fhoirmiúil a scríobh, nó taifead gníomh cineáltais neamhfhoirmiúil atá déanta agat cheana féin. Ní gá creidmheasanna ama le gar — ní thugtar ach aitheantas dó.

care_relationships.title: Caidrimh Chúraim
care_relationships.description: Déan nasc le duine dá dtugann tú cúram neamhfhoirmiúil, féach ar gach duine faoi do chúram in aon áit amháin, socraigh clúdach sealadach nuair a bhíonn faoiseamh uait nó nuair atá tú as baile, agus cuir caidreamh ar sos nó deireadh leis gan a stair a chailleadh.

hour_gifting_and_transfer.title: Bronnadh, Aistrithe agus Cúram Amach Anseo
hour_gifting_and_transfer.description: Bronn uaireanta atá curtha i dtaisce ar do theaghlach, ar chairde nó ar aon duine a bhfuil gá acu leo; tabhair na huaireanta leat má bhogann tú go pobal eile a úsáideann NEXUS; nó fág i gciste cúraim don todhchaí iad lena n-úsáid níos déanaí le haghaidh siopadóireachta, coinní nó comhluadair.

warmth_pass.title: Pas Teasa
warmth_pass.description: Dintiúr iontaobhais iniompartha a thuilleann ball nuair a shroicheann sé an leibhéal Iontaofa. Taispeántar ann na huaireanta atá taifeadta aige, léirmheasanna ó phiaraí, fíorú céannachta agus na réimsí ina dtugann sé cabhair. Taispeánann baill é d’fhaighteoirí cúraim, do chomhordaitheoirí agus d’eagraíochtaí mar chruthúnas gur cúntóirí iontaofa iad.

trust_tiers.title: Leibhéil Iontaobhais
trust_tiers.description: Seasamh an bhaill sa phobal, le miondealú soiléir ar an gcaoi ar thuill sé a leibhéal reatha agus ar a bhfuil riachtanach don chéad leibhéal eile.

care_providers.title: Eolaire Soláthraithe Cúraim
care_providers.description: Aimsigh seirbhísí cúraim áitiúla, ionaid lae, cumainn agus saorálaithe i do réigiún, chomh maith le cabhair idir baill.

safeguarding_reporting.title: Tuairisciú Imní
safeguarding_reporting.description: Is féidir le baill imní cosanta a thuairisciú iad féin. Déanann an fhoireann athbhreithniú uirthi, sannann siad í agus réitíonn siad í de réir loga gníomhaíochta nach féidir a athscríobh, ach cur leis.

surveys_and_projects.title: Suirbhéanna agus Tionscadail Chomhphobail
surveys_and_projects.description: Bailigh aiseolas struchtúrtha ó chónaitheoirí, ó chomhpháirtithe bardasacha agus ó fhoirne clár, agus comhordaigh tionscadail phobail leis na daoine atá páirteach iontu.

municipality_reporting.title: Tuairisciú Bardasach
municipality_reporting.description: Féilire bardasach comhroinnte, bosca isteach d’aiseolas cónaitheoirí a sheolann ceisteanna, smaointe, fadhbanna agus gearáin chuig an bhfoireann cheart, agus tuairisciú a tógadh do chomhpháirtithe comhairle agus earnála poiblí.

community_market.title: Margadh Comhphobail
community_market.description: Áit amháin chun seirbhísí ar creidmheasanna ama agus earraí áitiúla atá á dtairiscint sa phobal a aimsiú.

time_credit_redemption.title: Creidmheasanna Ama a Chaitheamh go hÁitiúil
time_credit_redemption.description: Feiceann baill na huaireanta atá tuillte acu agus caitheann siad iad i ngnólachtaí áitiúla rannpháirteacha, agus coinnítear stair iomlán ar gach úsáid.

caring_community_layer.intro: Ciseal comhchabhrach comhtháite a thugann cúram laethúil, obair dheonach, eagraíochtaí agus tionchar le chéile. Fanann sé múchta go dtí go roghnaíonn pobal é a chumasú, agus tugann an painéal riaracháin lipéad Alfa air, mar sin bíonn lipéad Réamhamhairc ar gach rud anseo.

enterprise_security.title: Slándáil fhiontair
enterprise_security.description: CSRF, teorannú ráta, 2FA TOTP, paseochracha WebAuthn, nonces CSP, liosta ceadaithe CORS, bailíochtú Form Request, geataí fíoraithe ríomhphoist agus clárú trí chód cuiridh.

stripe_payments_layer.title: Ciseal íocaíochtaí Stripe
stripe_payments_layer.description: Síntiúis, tabhartais, íocaíochtaí margaidh (Connect) agus fíorú aitheantais, le láimhseáil idimitheach webhook agus clúdach cuimsitheach tástála ar shreabhadh airgid.

gdpr_compliance_suite.title: Sraith chomhlíonta GDPR
gdpr_compliance_suite.description: Iarrataí ar shonraí, bainistíocht toiliúna, toiliú fianán, rianú sáruithe agus loga iniúchta iomlán.

fraud_and_abuse_detection.title: Brath calaoise agus mí-úsáide
fraud_and_abuse_detection.description: Foláirimh uathoibríocha ar ghníomhaíocht amhrasach agus modhnóireacht ábhair.

insurance_certificate_tracking.title: Rianú teastas árachais
insurance_certificate_tracking.description: Bainistíocht agus fíorú árachais d'oibrithe deonacha.

enterprise_rbac.title: RBAC fiontair
enterprise_rbac.description: Rialú rochtana bunaithe ar róil thar 13+ modúl le maitrís iomlán ceadanna.

wcag_2_1_aa_accessibility.title: Inrochtaineacht WCAG 2.1 AA
wcag_2_1_aa_accessibility.description: Comhlíonadh inrochtaineachta iniúchta ar fud na gcomhéadan a fheiceann úsáideoirí.

multi_language_support.title: Tacaíocht ilteangach
multi_language_support.description: 11 theanga: Béarla, Gaeilge, Gearmáinis, Fraincis, Iodáilis, Portaingéilis, Spáinnis, Ollainnis, Polainnis, Seapáinis agus Araibis (RTL iomlán).

self_hosted_prerendering.title: Réamhrindreáil féinóstáilte
self_hosted_prerendering.description: Léargais Playwright do róbónna amháin, a sheirbheáiltear ar ríomhchláir innéacsaithe SEO; faigheann úsáideoirí an SPA bheo i gcónaí.

guided_onboarding.title: Tús treoraithe
guided_onboarding.description: Draoi do bhaill nua le réamhshocruithe cliste.

admin_panel.title: Painéal riaracháin
admin_panel.description: Rialuithe algartam, diagnóisic, monatóireacht ar thascanna cron agus monatóireacht ar inseachadacht ríomhphoist.

email_webhook_processing.title: Próiseáil webhook ríomhphoist
email_webhook_processing.description: Láimhseáil preabanna, gearán, oscailtí agus imeachtaí seachadta ó Postmark.

openapi_3_0_specification.title: Sonraíocht OpenAPI 3.0
openapi_3_0_specification.description: Sonraíocht iomlán API le doiciméadacht Swagger UI.

fully_dockerized.title: Go hiomlán Dockeraithe
fully_dockerized.description: Ritheann an timpeallacht táirgthe agus an timpeallacht forbartha ar na bunsraitheanna Docker Compose céanna.

automated_test_suite.title: Sraith Tástála Uathoibrithe
automated_test_suite.description: Thart ar 16,500 modh tástála PHP i 1,600 comhad tástála, chomh maith le tuairim is 1,300 sraith tástála comhéadain, a chlúdaíonn sreabhadh airgid, webhooks, cónaidhm, grúpaí agus an margadh. Ritear iad tar éis gach brú chuig Git, agus cuirtear bac ar imscaradh go dtí go mbíonn an tiomantas a brúdh seiceáilte.

performance_monitoring.title: Monatóireacht Feidhmíochta
performance_monitoring.description: Déantar gach iarratas a chomhaireamh, agus taifeadtar go mion na hiarratais atá mall, a úsáideann an iomarca cuimhne nó a dhéanann an iomarca fiosruithe, lena dtaispeáint ar phainéal riaracháin. Ní stóráiltear ach struchtúr an fhiosraithe, agus ní stóráiltear sonraí ball riamh; scriostar seantaifid gach oíche.

partner_api_and_developer_portal.title: API Comhpháirtithe agus Tairseach Forbróirí
partner_api_and_developer_portal.note: Tógtha agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe. Níl aon chomhpháirtí seachtrach á úsáid faoi láthair.
partner_api_and_developer_portal.description: API doiciméadaithe a ligeann do chomhpháirtí seachtrach comhtháthú le pobal, le fíordheimhniú trí chomharthaí, tagairt do chríochphointí agus webhooks, chomh maith le tairseach forbróirí féinseirbhíse don fhorbróir atá ag tógáil an chomhtháthaithe.

local_advertising.title: Fógraíocht Áitiúil
local_advertising.description: Feachtais fógraíochta agus fógraí brú faoi stiúir an phobail, lena mbuiséadú agus lena n-uirlisí riaracháin féin, ionas gur féidir leis an bpobal gníomhaíocht áitiúil a chur chun cinn.
local_advertising.note: Tógtha agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe.

swiss_fadp_mode.title: Mód FADP na hEilvéise
swiss_fadp_mode.description: Meirge toilithe breise agus mód láimhseála sonraí do phobail atá ag feidhmiú faoin Acht Cónaidhme athbhreithnithe um Chosaint Sonraí san Eilvéis.
swiss_fadp_mode.note: Tógtha agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe.

regional_analytics.title: Anailísíocht Réigiúnach
regional_analytics.description: Tuarascálacha míosúla ar ghníomhaíocht réigiúnach, ullmhaithe do bhardais agus do chomhlachtaí réigiúnacha agus bainistithe go lárnach seachas ag gach pobal ar leith.
regional_analytics.note: Tógtha agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe.

community_onboarding.title: Ionduchtú Pobail Nua
community_onboarding.description: Conas a chuirtear pobal nua ar bun: foirm iarratais phoiblí, nasc a ligeann d’iarratasóirí a ndul chun cinn féin a rianú, bealach fiosrúcháin do réamhcheisteanna, agus uirlisí soláthair riaracháin chun an pobal a chumrú nuair a cheadaítear é.

ga.maturity_dormant: Tógtha, tástáilte agus múchta de réir réamhshocraithe. Tá an obair déanta agus iniúchta, ach níl aon rud á úsáid fós — forbróimid tuilleadh é nuair a bheidh fíorghá leis.
ga.availability_notice_title: Seans nach bhfuil gach ceann díobh seo cumasaithe do do phobal
ga.availability_notice_body: Taispeánann an leathanach seo gach rud is féidir le bogearraí Project NEXUS a dhéanamh. Ní liosta é de na gnéithe atá cumasaithe do do phobal féin.
ga.availability_notice_body_2: Roghnaíonn gach pobal na codanna is mian leis a úsáid, mar sin ní bheidh cuid de na rudaí thíos le feiceáil i do roghchláir. Tá sé sin normálta agus ní locht é — níor chumasaigh do phobal an chuid sin go fóill.
ga.availability_notice_body_3: Is féidir leat na gnéithe a fheiceann tú i do roghchláir féin a úsáid. Má fheiceann tú rud úsáideach anseo ach mura féidir leat é a aimsiú, iarr ar an té a reáchtálann do phobal é a chumasú.
ga.no_results_title: Níl aon rud ag teacht leis an gcuardach sin
ga.no_results_body: Bain triail as focal níos giorra, nó roghnaigh Gach rud chun an liosta iomlán a thabhairt ar ais.
ga.clear_filters: Glan an cuardach agus na scagairí

de.title: Funktionen
de.meta_description: Alle Module von Project NEXUS v1.6 mit ehrlichen Reifegrad-Kennzeichnungen für Föderation, Zeitbanking, Marktplatz, Community-Tools, Sicherheit, Analytik und Open-Source-Infrastruktur.
de.heading: Was Project NEXUS leistet
de.subheading: Project NEXUS ist eine mandantenfähige Community-Plattform der Unternehmensklasse. Jedes der folgenden Module wird heute in Version 1.5 ausgeliefert. Wir kennzeichnen Module ehrlich: Nicht gekennzeichnete Artikel sind allgemein verfügbar; neuere oder aktiv härtende Oberflächen tragen einen Beta- oder Preview-Chip; und ein eingebauter, nicht aktivierter Chip bedeutet, dass die Arbeit beendet und ausgeschaltet ist und auf Nachfrage gewartet wird.
de.maturity_ga: Allgemein verfügbar - stabil, unterstützt, produktiv in Pilot-Mandanten im Einsatz.
de.maturity_beta: Heute im Produktivbetrieb, aber die öffentliche Schnittstelle oder das Wire-Protokoll wird noch gehärtet.
de.maturity_preview: Kürzlich veröffentlicht und auf Wunsch nutzbar. Mit schneller Iteration rechnen - API und UX können sich ändern.
de.open_source_body: Project NEXUS ist vollständig Open Source unter AGPL-3.0. Jede Codezeile ist prüfbar, forkbar und selbst hostbar. Föderationsprotokolle sind als offene Standards dokumentiert, sodass keine einzelne Plattform das globale Zeitbanking-Netzwerk kontrolliert.
de.security_body_before: Ein Sicherheitsproblem entdeckt? Bitte melden Sie es vertraulich an
de.security_body_after: statt einen öffentlichen Issue zu erstellen. Die vollständige Richtlinie zur Schwachstellenmeldung finden Sie in SECURITY.md im Quellcode-Repository.

tech_stack.accessible_value: GOV.UK Frontend 6.4 + Express + Nunjucks, HTML-first und funktioniert ohne JavaScript

timebanking_engine.title: Zeitbanking-Engine
timebanking_engine.description: Vollständiges Kreditaustauschsystem mit Wallet, Transaktionen und Broker-Steuerung.

multi_tenancy.title: Mandantenfähigkeit
multi_tenancy.description: Beherbergen Sie beliebig viele Communities auf einer Plattform, jede mit eigenem Branding, eigener Konfiguration und eigenem Funktionsumfang.

tenant_hierarchy.title: Mandanten-Hierarchie
tenant_hierarchy.description: Eltern-Kind-Beziehungen zwischen Mandanten mit Funktionsumschaltung und föderierter Sichtbarkeit.

smart_matching.title: Smartes Matching
smart_matching.description: KI-gestütztes Matching mit semantischen Embeddings, kollaborativem Filtern, Verfügbarkeitsplanung und gelernten Präferenzen.

real_time_messaging.title: Echtzeit-Messaging
real_time_messaging.description: Private Konversationen mit Pusher-WebSocket-Integration und Echtzeit-Präsenz.

progressive_web_app.title: Progressive Web-App
progressive_web_app.description: Auf jedem Gerät als PWA installierbar - Offline-Shell, Push-Benachrichtigungen, NetworkFirst-Update-Flow.

native_mobile_app.title: Native Mobile-App
native_mobile_app.description: Eine separate App, die mit Expo und React Native erstellt wurde und mit derselben API wie die Website kommuniziert. Eine Codebasis produziert sowohl den Android- als auch den iOS-Build.
native_mobile_app.note: Die Web-App ist immer noch der Haupteinstiegspunkt und noch ist keiner der Store-Builds veröffentlicht. Android kommt dem am nächsten: Signierung, Build-Profile und Push-Benachrichtigungen sind alle vorhanden. iOS basiert auf dem gleichen Code, erfordert aber zusätzlich ein Apple-Entwicklerkonto und eine Überprüfung im App Store, daher wird es folgen.

accessible_frontend.title: Barrierefreies Frontend
accessible_frontend.description: Ein zweites, separates Frontend, das auf dem GOV.UK-Frontend basiert, für Mitglieder, die ein einfaches HTML-First-Erlebnis wünschen, das auch ohne JavaScript funktioniert. Es läuft unter seiner eigenen Webadresse und liest dieselbe API wie die Haupt-App.
accessible_frontend.note: Lebe heute. Jede Seite in der Haupt-App verfügt über eine entsprechende zugängliche Seite, aber jede Seite wird immer noch verhaltensabhängig mit der Haupt-App verglichen, weshalb sie das Label „Beta“ und nicht „GA“ trägt.

explore_discovery.title: Entdecken
explore_discovery.description: Eine kuratierte Seite, auf der Fähigkeiten, Einträge, Ereignisse, Gruppen, Beiträge und sehenswerte Personen angezeigt werden, sodass Mitglieder nicht jeden Abschnitt durchsuchen müssen, um sie zu finden.

maps_and_location.title: Karten- und Standortanbieter
maps_and_location.description: Kartierung und Adresssuche sind pro Community steckbar: Google Maps-, OpenStreetMap- oder Ordnance Survey-Kacheln, gepaart mit Google Places, Nominatim oder UPRN-gestützter OS Places-Adressvalidierung. Karten bleiben deaktiviert, bis eine Community sie aktiviert, sodass standardmäßig nie ein Zuordnungsschlüssel den Browser erreicht.

federation.title: Föderation
federation.intro: „Föderation“ bedeutet hier zwei verschiedene Dinge, und sie befinden sich in unterschiedlichen Stadien. Die Verbindung von Gemeinschaften, die auf einer Installation leben, ist Alltag. Die Verbindung zu anderen Installationen und anderen Plattformen ist erstellt und getestet, aber standardmäßig deaktiviert und wird derzeit nicht verwendet.

federation_network.title: Community-Netzwerk (gleiche Installation)
federation_network.description: Verknüpfen Sie mehrere Communitys, die auf einer Installation gehostet werden, um Community-übergreifende Entdeckungen, Einträge, Ereignisse und Nachrichten zu ermöglichen.

external_partner_federation.title: Externe Partner-Föderation
external_partner_federation.description: Stellen Sie über vier dokumentierte Protokolle eine Verbindung zu anderen NEXUS-Installationen und anderen Timebanking-Plattformen her: Nexus native, Komunitin, Credit Commons (CEN-kompatibel) und TimeOverflow.
external_partner_federation.note: Vollständig und getestet und standardmäßig ausgeschaltet – jeder externe Endpunkt antwortet mit einer vorübergehend nicht verfügbaren Antwort, bis ein Operator sie aktiviert. Heute ist kein externer Partner angeschlossen. Andere Plattformbetreiber haben Interesse bekundet, sodass die Grundlagen vorhanden und geprüft sind. Wir entwickeln sie jedoch erst dann weiter, wenn eine konkrete Integration auf dem Tisch liegt. Wenn Sie mit uns zusammenarbeiten möchten, nehmen Sie Kontakt mit uns auf.

multi_protocol_adapters.title: Multi-Protokoll-Adapter
multi_protocol_adapters.description: Adapter für die bidirektionale Synchronisierung von 9 Entitätstypen – Mitglieder, Einträge, Ereignisse, Gruppen, Verbindungen, Freiwilligenarbeit, Bewertungen, Übertragungen, Nachrichten – über alle vier Protokolle hinweg.
multi_protocol_adapters.note: Zusammen mit der External Partner Federation entwickelt und getestet und aus dem gleichen Grund ruhend: Nichts ist eingeschaltet, also wird nichts synchronisiert.

federation_neighborhoods.title: Föderations-Nachbarschaften
federation_neighborhoods.description: Geografisch gruppierte Cluster verbundener Gemeinden zur regionalen Koordination.

federation_analytics.title: Föderations-Analytik
federation_analytics.description: Admin-Dashboards für Community-übergreifende Aktivitäten, Synchronisierungszustand und föderiertes Transaktionsvolumen.

partner_network_portal.title: Netzwerk- und Partnerportal
partner_network_portal.description: Ein spezieller Bereich für alle, die ein Netzwerk von Communities statt einer einzelnen betreiben: ein Partnerverzeichnis, Nachbarschaftsgruppierung, Kreditverträge, netzwerkweite Einstellungen, kombinierte Aktivitäten und Analysen, Datenverwaltung und API-Schlüssel mit eigener Dokumentation.
partner_network_portal.note: Die Teile, die andere Installationen erreichen – externe Partner, eingehende API-Partner und Credit Commons – bleiben vom Rest der externen Föderation abgeschaltet. Die internen Netzwerktools sind im täglichen Einsatz.

service_listings.title: Dienstleistungs-Inserate
service_listings.description: Angebote und Gesuche einstellen, Inserate durchsuchen und smart matchen.

marketplace.title: Marktplatz
marketplace.description: Ein separates Kleinanzeigenmodul für Waren und kostenpflichtige Dienstleistungen: Verkäuferprofile und Onboarding, Bestellungen und Verkäufe, Stripe Connect-Auszahlungen, ein Gratis- und Giveaway-Bereich, Sammlungen, eine Kartenansicht, Abholplätze mit QR-Scanning, Versandoptionen, Verkäufercoupons, Fallbearbeitung bei Streitfällen und von der KI vorgeschlagene Antworten.

donations.title: Spenden
donations.description: Einmalige und wiederkehrende Spenden via Stripe mit vollständigen Dashboards und Spendenquittungen für Organisationen.

identity_verification.title: Identitätsprüfung
identity_verification.description: Optionaler Stripe-Identity-Ablauf (Dokument + Selfie + Abgleich von Name/Geburtsdatum) mit verifiziertem Mitgliedsabzeichen.

exchange_workflow.title: Austausch-Workflow
exchange_workflow.description: Strukturierter Lebenszyklus für Dienstleistungstausch mit Broker-Freigabe und Streitbeilegung.

group_exchanges.title: Gruppenaustausch
group_exchanges.description: Sammeltausch von Dienstleistungen über mehrere Mitglieder hinweg.

social_feed.title: Sozialer Feed
social_feed.description: Beiträge, Kommentare, Likes, Umfragen, Hashtags, Sprachnachrichten, Medienanhänge, Link-Vorschauen und @Erwähnungen.

stories.title: Geschichten
stories.description: Ephemere 24-Stunden-Foto- und -Video-Stories mit Reaktionen, Umfragen und Highlights.

presence_system.title: Präsenz-System
presence_system.description: Echtzeit-Online-/Offline-Status mit Datenschutzeinstellungen und individuellen Statusmeldungen.

events_and_groups.title: Veranstaltungen und Gruppen
events_and_groups.description: Community-Treffen und interessenbasierte Gruppen mit Einladungen, Mitgliedschaftsregeln, Erinnerungen und Gruppendiskussionen.

connections.title: Verbindungen
connections.description: Folgen und vernetzen Sie sich mit anderen Community-Mitgliedern.

members_directory.title: Mitgliederverzeichnis
members_directory.description: Durchsuchen, filtern und entdecken Sie Menschen in Ihrer Community.

gamification.title: Gamifizierung
gamification.description: Verifizierungsabzeichen, Journeys, XP, Bestenlisten, Erfolge, Challenges, Streaks, XP-Shop-Belohnungen, Community-Dashboard und saisonale Wettbewerbe.

goals_and_impact.title: Ziele & Wirkung
goals_and_impact.description: Verfolgen Sie persönliche Ziele und Gemeinschaftsergebnisse mit Mentoring und Liefer-Nachverfolgung.

ideation_challenges.title: Ideen-Challenges
ideation_challenges.description: Innovations-Hub mit Kampagnen, Ideen, Abstimmungen und Ergebnis-Tracking.

volunteering.title: Freiwilligenarbeit
volunteering.description: Freiwilligen-Einsätze, Stundenerfassung, Check-ins, Spesen, Zertifikate, Wohlbefindens-Monitoring, Notfallalarme und ein Freiwilligenorganisations-Wallet, das Zeitgutschriften für genehmigte Stunden auszahlt.

job_vacancies.title: Stellenangebote
job_vacancies.description: Ein vollständiges Rekrutierungsmodul: offene Stellen und Bewerbungen, eine Drag-and-Drop-Einstellungspipeline, Talentsuche, Arbeitgeberprofile und Branding, Arbeitgeber-Onboarding, gespeicherte Stellenbenachrichtigungen, Analysen pro Stellenangebot sowie ein öffentlicher RSS- und JSON-Feed, damit Job-Aggregatoren Stellenausschreibungen abrufen können.

organisations.title: Organisationen
organisations.description: Unternehmens- und Arbeitgeberprofile mit Unterkonten und eigenem Organisations-Wallet.

polls.title: Umfragen
polls.description: Community-Abstimmungen und Umfragen mit verschiedenen Fragetypen.

skills_browse.title: Fähigkeiten erkunden
skills_browse.description: Erkunden Sie die Fähigkeiten-Taxonomie und entdecken Sie Fachwissen.

availability_scheduling.title: Verfügbarkeitsplanung
availability_scheduling.description: Zeitzonenbewusste Zeitslot-Planung für smartes Matching und Buchungen.

courses.title: Kurse
courses.description: Community-Lernen: Mitglieder führen Kurse mit Lektionen und Tests durch, andere Mitglieder melden sich an und bearbeiten sie, und Kursleiter können die Arbeit bewerten, sehen, wie ein Kurs abschneidet, und am Ende ein Zertifikat ausstellen.

podcasts.title: Podcasts und Community-Audio
podcasts.description: Community-Shows, Audio-Storys, Interviews und von Mitgliedern aufgezeichnetes lokales Wissen, mit Episoden, Transkripten, Kapiteln, Moderation und einem öffentlichen RSS-Feed, der in gewöhnlichen Podcast-Apps funktioniert.

clubs_and_associations.title: Vereine und Verbände
clubs_and_associations.description: Mitgliedschaftsverwaltung für Clubs und Verbände: Beitragsverfolgung, Massenimport von Mitgliedern und Einladungen, die für alle verbundenen Clubs funktionieren.

public_events.title: Öffentliche Veranstaltungen
public_events.description: Ermöglichen Sie Personen ohne Konto, veröffentlichte Veranstaltungen zu durchsuchen und zu lesen. Für die Anmeldung ist noch ein Login erforderlich.

event_attendance_credits.title: Anwesenheitsprämien
event_attendance_credits.description: Vergeben Sie beim verifizierten Event-Check-in Zeitguthaben, die der Community zugute kommen und nicht vom Gastgeber abgezogen werden, sodass die Durchführung einer Veranstaltung nie mit persönlichen Kosten verbunden ist.
event_attendance_credits.note: Standardmäßig deaktiviert, und der Schalter allein kann keine Credits verschieben: Ein Betreiber muss außerdem die Treasury-Prägung aktivieren und einen Betrag pro Ereignis festlegen.

partner_venues.title: Partner-Veranstaltungsorte
partner_venues.description: Erfassen Sie Besuche von Mitgliedern an lokalen Partnerstandorten, indem Sie den QR-Code des Mitgliedsausweises scannen. Es wird nur der Besuch erfasst – die Plattform stellt keinen Coupon aus und gewährt keinen Rabatt.

collections_and_bookmarks.title: Sammlungen und gespeicherte Elemente
collections_and_bookmarks.description: Speichern Sie Einträge, Mitglieder und Beiträge und gruppieren Sie sie in Sammlungen, die Sie mit anderen Mitgliedern teilen können.

guardian_consent.title: Einwilligung des Erziehungsberechtigten
guardian_consent.description: Zustimmung der Erziehungsberechtigten für minderjährige Freiwillige oder Veranstaltungsteilnehmende: Einmal-Zustimmungslinks, verschlüsselte Angaben der Erziehungsberechtigten und ein Zustimmungsverlauf, der nur ergänzt, aber nie bearbeitet werden kann.
guardian_consent.note: Project NEXUS ist für Erwachsene — bei der Registrierung muss bestätigt werden, dass man 18 Jahre oder älter ist. Dies richtet sich an Gemeinschaften, die betreute Angebote mit jungen Menschen durchführen, bei denen eine Koordinatorin oder ein Koordinator das Konto anlegt. Es ist ausgeschaltet, sofern eine Gemeinschaft es nicht aktiviert.

member_premium.title: Spenden & Unterstützung
member_premium.description: Mitglieder können eine einmalige Spende tätigen oder eine regelmäßige Spende einrichten, um die Community zu unterstützen, die ihre Zeitbank betreibt, und diese jederzeit selbst verwalten oder stoppen. Unterstützer werden dafür gewürdigt – es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine kostenpflichtige Stufe, und kein Teil der Plattform wird jemals hinter einer Zahlung zurückgestellt.

event_operations.title: Veranstaltungsbetrieb
event_operations.description: Alles, was für die tatsächliche Durchführung einer Veranstaltung erforderlich ist: Ticketausstellung und Registrierung, Wartelisten, Pläne für wiederkehrende Veranstaltungen, eine Agenda mit Rednern, QR-Check-in, der auch dann funktioniert, wenn das Signal abfällt, Details zur Barrierefreiheit, Sicherheitshinweise, Teilnehmernachrichten, wiederverwendbare Vorlagen, Analysen pro Veranstaltung und eine vollständige Historie aller Änderungen.

merchant_coupons.title: Händlergutscheine
merchant_coupons.description: Von Marktplatz-Händlern ausgestellte Rabattgutscheine. Wird bewusst vom Zeitguthaben getrennt gehalten und erfordert auch die Aktivierung des Marktplatzes.

hiring_bias_audit.title: Prüfung der Einstellungsvoreingenommenheit
